title: SocialContext
description: One decision moment. The JSON payload of the /social_context topic, published by the fusion node at 2-5 Hz. See SCHEMA.md for field rationale and the migration mapping from the two earlier shapes.

schema_version.description: Increment on any breaking change. Consumers reject a major they do not know.

t.description: Unix timestamp of the sensor observation, not of publication. The audio node's stamp maps here.

since_last_decision_s.description: Seconds since the initiator last produced a decision. Written by the initiator, not the fusion node.

ambient.description: Owned by the audio node. Every field is optional; omit or null what was not measured. All fields are null while the robot is speaking, because the microphone only hears the robot.

noise_db.description: A-weighted sound level. Only from a calibrated microphone; dBFS is not a substitute. Omit if uncalibrated.

noise_floor_db.description: Room level with nobody talking, in dBFS (more negative is quieter). Uncalibrated. Null until enough quiet audio has been heard.

noise_level.description: The audio node's label for noise_floor_db. Prefer this over the raw number.

speech_snr_db.description: How far a voice rises above noise_floor_db. Large is close and clear, small is distant or drowned out. Null when there is no voice to measure.

speech_ratio_10s.description: Fraction of the last 10 s that contained speech. High means a conversation is underway.

seconds_since_speech.description: Length of the current pause; 0 while someone is talking. Null means nobody has spoken yet, which is not a long pause.

other_speech_active.description: Someone other than the robot is speaking. Default false.

speech_sources_estimated.description: Concurrent speakers. Null means the audio node cannot count them.

target.description: The one person the robot would address. Null when nobody is present -- the gate keys off this and suppresses without an LLM call. Owned by the vision node.

gaze_at_robot_s.description: Seconds of sustained gaze on the robot. 0 means not looking. Duration rather than a boolean: a bool is derivable as (gaze_at_robot_s > 0), the reverse is not.

motion.description: Four-way, not a moving/not-moving bool. 'passing' and 'approaching' are both movement and imply opposite actions.

in_conversation.description: This person is talking with someone else. Drives R1, the highest-priority rule. Present on the target, not only on bystanders.

activity.description: Controlled vocabulary, not free text. 'working' is what R4 keys off.

bearing_deg.description: Signed angle from robot forward. Negative is left.

dwell_s.description: Seconds this person has been in view.

speech.description: Null until the audio node emits transcripts. Required for the 'respond' action; without it the robot can only initiate. The audio node's transcript maps to partial_transcript; it is only filled once robot.engaged is true.

syntactically_complete.description: Cheap stand-in for a turn-taking model. A part-of-speech heuristic captures most of the value.

bystanders.description: Everyone else visible. Empty list means nobody else, which is different from the vision node being unable to tell.

robot.description: Owned by the initiator node. No other node writes these.

is_speaking.description: The robot is talking. The audio node's robot_speaking maps here; while true, ambient is not measured.

engaged.description: The robot is already in a conversation. Gates transcription in the audio node. Not a measure of whether the person wants contact.

last_spoke_s_ago.description: Null means never. Canonical source for 'greeted recently' -- that is a threshold applied by the gate, not a field a sensor publishes.

consecutive_no_response.description: Times this person was addressed and did not respond. Drives R2.

recent_decisions.description: Newest first. Prevents the robot repeating itself, the most common failure mode in systems of this kind.
